full_prompt_en: The image is a square, finely textured fantasy illustration of a black panther's face in extreme close-up against a dark ornamental night ground. The head fills nearly the whole frame, cropped across the top, right, and bottom so that the nose and muzzle approach the left edge. Its face turns slightly left and upward, with one large pale gold eye near the upper right as the clearest focal point. A second eye is only partly visible in shadow farther left along the brow. Minute cool gray strokes describe the velvety black fur, with darker rosette-like markings across the forehead and cheek that appear only where light catches them. The rounded black nose has a muted silver-brown highlight along its upper rim. Beneath it, the closed mouth and dense muzzle remain subdued, while many long thin white whiskers fan outward across the lower half and extend into the shadows at both sides. At the upper left, a small circular pale orb sits inside a dark decorative ring. Fine curling lines and faint dots occupy the surrounding black background, suggesting an ornate nocturnal pattern without creating a distant landscape. A few tan highlights brush the ridge above the muzzle and the area near the eyes, keeping the animal's form visible within the nearly black palette. The light appears cool and low from the upper left, with a separate bright catchlight in the golden eye and silver tips along the whiskers. The fur texture is intricately rendered, while the background spirals and small specks stay flatter and quieter so they do not compete with the face. There is almost no empty space: cropped fur, whiskers, and dark ornament fill every edge, yet the light eye anchors the dense composition. The overall image balances black-on-black surface detail with one luminous gold focal point and fine pale lines, creating a watchful, mysterious mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、肌理精细的幻想插画，黑豹面孔以极近距离呈现在暗色装饰性夜幕前。头部几乎填满全幅，在上、右和下边被裁切，鼻子与口鼻部接近左边缘。它的脸略朝左上转，一只大的浅金色眼睛位于右上附近，是最清楚的焦点。第二只眼睛只在眉下更左侧的阴影中露出一部分。细密冷灰色笔痕描出天鹅绒般的黑毛，额头和脸颊的深色玫瑰斑纹只在承光处隐约显出。圆润黑鼻子的上缘有低调银棕色高光。其下闭合的嘴与厚实的口鼻部保持暗淡，许多细长白须从下半部向外扇开，并伸入两侧阴影。左上方一颗小而浅色的圆球嵌在暗色装饰圆环中。周围黑底上有细卷线与淡淡小点，暗示华饰夜纹，而没有展开远处风景。口鼻脊上与眼周有少量褐色提亮，使动物形体在近黑配色里仍可看见。光似乎从左上方冷冷地低照，金眼里另有一颗亮眼神光，胡须边缘则有银色细线。毛发肌理刻画繁密，背景卷纹与小点更平、更安静，不与面部争夺注意。几乎没有空白，裁切的黑毛、胡须和暗纹填满各边，但发亮的眼睛稳住密集构图。整体图像以黑上加黑的表面细节，对照一处明亮金色焦点与细浅线条，形成警觉而神秘的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Finely rendered digital illustration works within a near-black range, using minute cool gray marks to reveal surface rather than filling it with broad light. Deep charcoal, blue-black, and muted bronze cover most of the frame; one compact gold highlight creates the strongest contrast. Fine pale lines spread across the dark lower area, while faint curls and pinpoints remain embedded in the background. Edges emerge selectively from darkness, with the clearest contour and sharpest specular detail concentrated near the focal region. Low cool illumination and tiny warm reflections make rounded volume readable without brightening the whole image. An extreme close crop lets texture and one luminous detail dominate, leaving little empty ground. The overall treatment is dense, nocturnal, and tactile, with restrained color and precise microcontrast sustaining the image.
style_prompt_zh: 刻画精细的数字插画在近黑色域里工作，以细密冷灰记号显露表面，而非用大片亮光填满。深炭灰、蓝黑与低饱和古铜色覆盖大部分画面，一处紧凑金色高光形成最强反差。浅色细线散过下部暗区，淡卷纹与针尖小点埋在背景里。边缘有选择地从黑暗中浮出，最清楚的轮廓和最锐利的镜面亮点聚在焦点附近。低位冷光与细小暖色反射使圆润体积可读，却没有照亮全画面。极近裁切让纹理和一处发亮细节占主导，留给空白底面的空间很少。整体处理密集、夜色浓重而可感，以克制色彩和精确的微反差支撑图像。
theme_en: An extreme close-up of a black panther's face against a dark ornamental night ground
theme_zh: 黑豹面孔的极近景，背景是暗色装饰性夜幕
name: Lisa Parker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
